skill.summary: Query YY game trading marketplace listings by game and category; guides users to the website for actual buy/sell actions

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Game Market skill.
- Lets users browse and search YY game trading marketplace listings by game and category.
- Supports popular games and trading types (accounts, boosting, coaching, items, currency).
- Interactive chat flow guides users through selecting game and category, viewing listings, and paginating.
- Provides direct links to items or marketplace homepage for buy/sell actions.
- No login required for browsing; purchases and sales redirect to the YY website.
